classification.difficultyReason: Follow the supplied addition rule through two dependent levels, combining variable terms and constants and recognising cancellation at the top.

content.prompt: Complete each pyramid. Each expression is the sum of the two expressions below it.

spec.description: Three unshaded tiers with diagonal addition connectors. Bottom row a + 2, 1, a; two writable middle rectangles and one writable top rectangle.
spec.mathematics: Each upper entry is the sum of the adjacent pair directly below.
spec.answerVisibility: Bottom givens visible; middle and top answers hidden.

answer.worked:
Middle left, middle right, then top:
$$\begin{align*}(a+2)+1&=a+3\\1+a&=a+1\\(a+3)+(a+1)&=2a+4\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Completed pyramid in the same coordinate frame as the question.
spec.mathematics: Middle entries a + 3 and a + 1; top entry 2a + 4.
spec.answerVisibility: All entries visible in the solution only.
